canonical_project: Cato hyperscale data centre near Auchtertool

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: DCD reports ILI Group submitted an application to Fife Council for planning permission in principle for Cato, a proposed 600MW hyperscale data centre near Auchtertool in Fife. Development is described as 25 ha with up to seven buildings and an on-site substation.
